thread:
Maya: quick QA thread for the Autoscale compact row mock. Goals: clarify Min/Max labels, de-emphasize Burst, ensure keyboard + screen reader behavior. mock: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/autoscale-qa.png

Tom: love the compact row. tiny nit: use explicit short labels: 'Min GPUs' / 'Max GPUs' and show unit near values (e.g., '4 GPUs').

Maya: agreed. helper under inputs: 'per-pool GPU instances' for clarity.

Jorge: infra note: values are ints for the scheduler. on pool change we must validate immediately. plan: fetch constraints and cache last 5 responses. debounce 250ms on mobile.

Leah: a11y checklist: 1) visible focus ring on steppers and picker, 2) stepper exposes aria-valuenow/min/max, 3) inline validation uses role=alert and doesn't rely on color.

Leah: suggested mapping: connect custom stepper to a visually-hidden <input type=number> that has aria-label/min/max/value. preserves native keyboard behavior.

Aria: SLO copy: label 'SLO (p95 ms)' and muted helper 'Lower = stricter. Recommend quantization or smaller models if breached.'

Tom: Burst: move to secondary row as 'Allow burst capacity' with helper 'Temporarily exceeds Max; billed only for extra GPUs used.' reduces misclicks and misperception.

Maya: pilot users thought burst was free; need confirmation modal that shows estimated cost + SLO risk.

Jorge: we can estimate cost from recent usage but mark as estimate. when modal opens re-check pool limits; show error if requested burst exceeds hard limit. emit telemetry autoscale.burstModal.shown/confirmed/estimate_error.

Leah: modal a11y: focus-trap, restore focus on close, ESC to close, announce when estimate loads (aria-live polite). Make confirm button labeled 'Enable burst' and place it first in DOM for SR users.

Aria: microcopy for modal summary: 'Burst temporarily exceeds Max. Billed only for extra GPUs used. Estimated additional cost: ~$12/mo. SLO risk: May increase p95 latency; we'll fallback to a smaller model if breached.'

Tom: inline validation UX: show small callout 'Selected pool max: 6 GPUs 14 your Min: 8.' actions 'Adjust to 6' / 'Keep 8'. role=alert for screen readers.

Leah: callout must include icon + text, not color alone. animate only when prefers-reduced-motion is false. buttons must announce results, e.g., 'Min updated to 6 GPUs'.

Maya: next steps: Tom updates mock with inline picker + secondary burst row + billing helper; Jorge to implement hidden input mapping and debounce/cache; Leah to run VoiceOver + contrast pass tomorrow AM; Aria to finalize modal microcopy. I'll post updated image when ready.

design-bot: New mock uploaded: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/autoscale-qa-v2.png

Maya: thanks team!
